messages:
Maya - Partnerships: FYI, PanAsia SI asking for a temporary reseller margin of 18% for a 6mo pilot instead of our standard 25%. They want to onboard 3 customers; estimated usage ~ $30k total commit. Requesting deal-desk approval.
Tom - Deal Desk: Can you post the proposed rate card and the rationale? Need to see how the concession affects unit economics.
Maya - Partnerships: Rationale: pilot will unlock 3-year SI certification and a distribution channel across APAC. Expect conversion to full-priced engagements after pilot. Customer list: 3 targets (finance, logistics, healthcare).
Maya - Partnerships: ```
rate_card:
  hosted_api: $0.030 / 1k tokens
  embeddings: $0.0007 / unit
  reseller_margin: 18%
  commit: $30,000
  term: 6 months
```
Ava - Finance: Quick calc — at 18% reseller margin our gross margin after infra is ~22% vs ~31% at 25%. Need expected ARR uplift to justify.
Raj - Sales: We model ~200k ARR in year 1 from the accounts and SI-led pipeline if pilot succeeds. Upside on cross-sell into other APAC customers too.
Tom - Deal Desk: How do we protect price integrity post-pilot? Recommend reversion clause: automatic reversion to standard rates at renewal, no retroactive discounts, 30d notice for renewals. Also need commit verification (payment/usage).
Elena - Legal: I'll draft amendment with reversion + audit rights and commit verification language. Also flagged: data residency — PanAsia plans to host PoC infra in SG. Need confirmation customers keep data in customer VPC or approved partner infra.
Maya - Partnerships: PanAsia confirmed customers' data stays in customer's VPC for PoC; partner will provide access but no data co-mingling. They agreed to audit rights and reversion.
Tom - Deal Desk: Ok prelim sign-off pending final finance ok. @Ava can you approve NPV/threshold? If below threshold, escalate to CRO.
op-bot: Deal Desk request created: DD-4821 — assigned to Tom.
Ava - Finance: Approving exception at 18% for 6 months conditional on (1) $30k commit received or invoiced up front, (2) legal amendment signed with reversion & audit, and (3) PoC infra attestation. :white_check_mark:
Tom - Deal Desk: Approved. I'll update DD record with conditions and add clause snippets.
Maya - Partnerships: Thanks all — I'll tell PanAsia the decision and share the amendment draft when Elena posts it. AE will be looped in to start SOW + deployment schedule.
Elena - Legal: Draft incoming, will post in this thread when ready for review.
